summary.description: EVE identifies the 30PL as a 3.0Ah, 3.65V tabless 18650 cell with a temperature-limited maximum discharge. Battery Mooch tested the exact EVE 30PL and estimated about 45A true continuous current, distinct from the 60A temperature-limited maximum. Exact vape-market retail evidence exists in Japan, while the manufacturer presents the cell for power tools and other industrial applications; preserve temperature and no-vape-approval caveats. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
